Subject: Re: PoC kickoff — networking & auth questions

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks before we start the PoC:

1) Network — we'd prefer a VPC endpoint / private-link style connection so traffic doesn't traverse public internet. Can you confirm what AWS constructs Redwood supports? VPC endpoint vs Transit Gateway?
2) IP allowlist — we'll lock down egress to your IP ranges. Can you share the CIDR/IP set for the eu-west region? How often does it change?
3) mTLS — our security team wants mutual TLS at the TLS layer, in addition to SDK auth tokens. Is that supported for Private deployments or only for Dedicated?
4) SDK auth — we'll use client certs + short-lived tokens. How does token rotation and KMS integration look from your side?
5) Structured output/tool calling — we plan to call a reranker in our infra; want to confirm how Redwood's structured output and tool-calling can POST to an internal endpoint behind our VPC.

Attachment: network_topology_draft.png (image/png)

Appreciate a short runbook and any sample configs. Jordan
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@brightpay.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC kickoff — networking & auth questions

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear list. Recap + next steps below (keeping to action items):

Network
- Supported connectivity: Redwood Private (VPC-onramp) supports AWS PrivateLink (interface VPC endpoints) and VPC peering via Transit Gateway. For eu-west we recommend PrivateLink for single-tenant control; Transit Gateway is an option for multi-account setups.
- Public hosted API remains an option but traffic will traverse public egress. For the PoC we'll plan PrivateLink.

IP ranges
- We'll provide a stable set of egress IPs for your region; they are published and updated monthly. For the PoC we'll allocate a /28 static pool for BrightPay.

mTLS
- mTLS is supported on Private deployments. We can require client certs at the edge and additionally validate tokens. For Hosted we only support token-based auth.

SDK auth & token rotation
- SDKs will accept client certs for mutual TLS; tokens are short-lived (15m) and issued by our auth service. We support KMS/HSM-backed signing for enterprise customers.

Structured output / tool calling
- Structured output can POST to endpoints reachable from our runtime. For private connectivity we can route callbacks back into your VPC via the PrivateLink endpoint. We'll need the internal URL and a way to trust our certs.

Action items (owners & ETA)
- Redwood: send CIDR/IP set and example security group rules — owner: ben_carter — ETA: 2026-07-16 EOD
- BrightPay: provide internal endpoint, port, and TLS certs/thumbprint for mTLS — owner: Jordan — ETA: 2026-07-19
- Create PoC config bundle (network_config_example.yaml + IaC snippets) — owner: laura_bennett — ETA: 2026-07-17

I'll attach a short onramp checklist and sample config. Happy to jump on a follow-up call.

— Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
